description: agweather-qaqc is a Python command-line package for reviewing daily weather-station observations. Its developers provide import from differing network formats and units, interactive time-series checks, flags and adjustments, and reference evapotranspiration calculations. The JOSS paper connects these steps to irrigation and water-use estimation. Spatial coverage is the station network supplied, and temporal resolution is daily over its observation period. The public repository reports Apache-2.0, so the software is free; the measurements come from separate providers. An irrigation modeller can clean meteorological inputs before estimating crop water demand or testing drought scenarios. A caveat is that filling gaps or correcting outliers relies on judgment and cannot recover an unmeasured local climate. Calculated evapotranspiration is not actual field water use without crop, soil and management assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was found. The article and own repository were read without downloading station data or running the tool.
